gloss: film adaptation; making into a movie

definitions.gloss: film adaptation; making into a movie
definitions.explanation: The act or result of adapting a novel, manga, stage play, or other work into a feature film. Commonly used with する to form a verb meaning 'to adapt (something) into a film.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{映画化|えいがか}。
examples.english: A film adaptation of a novel.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{映画化|えいがか}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This manga was adapted into a film.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最新作|さいしんさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧{映画化|えいがか}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The latest work by the popular author is scheduled to be adapted into a film next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原作|げんさく}→原作：11827_gensaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忠実|ちゅうじつ}→忠実：12570_chuujitsu⟧な{映画化|えいがか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{批評家|ひひょうか}→批評家：19430_hihyouka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was highly praised by critics as a film adaptation faithful to the original work.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ ('film; movie') and the suffix ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ ('-ization; turning into'). Very productive pattern that appears in many compound nouns: {映画化|えいがか}, ⟦{ドラマ化|どらまか}→ドラマ化：26046_doramaka⟧ ('TV drama adaptation'), {漫画化|まんがか} ('manga adaptation'), etc.

USAGE:
Used both as a noun (a film adaptation) and with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb (to adapt into a film). The passive {映画化|えいがか}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ is extremely common in news and entertainment writing, since the original work is usually the topic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{映画化|えいがか}: a film adaptation of a novel
- {映画化|えいがか}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be adapted into a film
- {映画化|えいがか}⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧: film adaptation confirmed
- {映画化|えいがか}{権|けん}: film adaptation rights
- ⟦{原作|げんさく}→原作：11827_gensaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忠実|ちゅうじつ}→忠実：12570_chuujitsu⟧な{映画化|えいがか}: a faithful film adaptation
- ⟦{実写|じっしゃ}→実写：12271_jissha⟧{映画化|えいがか}: live-action film adaptation

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{ドラマ化|どらまか}→ドラマ化：26046_doramaka⟧: TV drama adaptation
- {舞台化|ぶたいか}: stage adaptation
- ⟦{アニメ化|あにめか}→アニメ化：23065_animeka⟧: anime adaptation
- ⟦{原作|げんさく}→原作：11827_gensaku⟧: the original work (novel, manga, etc.)
- ⟦{脚色|きゃくしょく}→脚色：18162_kyakushoku⟧: dramatic adaptation; scripting
